data_description.states: Leave empty to tell since when the source has been in the state it is in now. Fill in, for example `on`, to tell since when it last became that state, which stays put after it changes again.

user.description: This helper tells since when an entity has been in its state, and keeps that across restarts. A moment of the entity being unavailable does not count as a change.
user.title: Time in state 👻
